title: CVEvolve: Autonomous Algorithm Discovery for Unstructured Scientific Data Processing

mechanism.domainTask: Autonomous development of scientific data-processing algorithms for unstructured imaging tasks
mechanism.populationDetail: A persistent candidate pool is grouped by lineage; candidates store parent IDs, and two-parent crossover creates a lineage ancestry graph rather than a strict tree.
mechanism.archiveDetail: The search retains a persistent candidate pool and samples among performance-ranked candidates across lineages; no separate bounded descriptor-cell archive is specified.
mechanism.replacementDetail: SQL-backed candidate history with multi-parent lineage tracking; not a conventional fixed-size generation replacement scheme.
mechanism.generationDetail: Generate is from-scratch; Tune makes fine-grained unary edits; Evolve fuses two parent algorithms, falling back to unary mutation if only one candidate exists.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Development metric, holdout metric, candidate analysis, failure records, and lineage are stored in the SQL search-state database.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: Tune samples one parent; Evolve samples two with a same-lineage penalty. Sampling is Gibbs over performance rank, with deterministic top-k fallback.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: Agent-managed workspace/evaluator construction, scientific-image visualization, and a separate holdout-testing agent for underspecified scientific data workflows.

provenance.sourcePdf: additional_papers/202605/CVEvolve Autonomous Algorithm Discovery for Unstructured Scientific Data Processing.pdf
provenance.citationWarning: Although lineage-aware sampling is MAP-Elites-inspired, the paper does not specify descriptor-cell admission for a QD archive. The policy selecting Generate/Tune/Evolve is not explicit enough for a stable taxonomy label.
